lessons_used: Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 6 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 10 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) and redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 2 tests each (up to +8.7% and +9.0%), though several hurt performance and most showed no clear effect.
Copy updates (copy) were helpful in 1 test (+5.7%), but showed no clear effect in 7 tests.
Step reordering (reorder), hints, notifications, and new flows produced no winning tests; step reordering hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and no clear effect was seen in the rest.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

candidates.why: Choose path has an 80.9% conversion rate and support emails indicate post-adoption confusion regarding companion behavior. New screens have a strong historical win rate (up to +15.4%).

candidates.change: Add a security guarantee hint to the sign-in screen assuring users that sign-in preserves companion memory.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited fear or experience of pets missing/reset after sign-in. Clear hints reduce sign-in dropoff (84.3%).

guard.reason: Adding a security guarantee hint to sign-in does not violate any rules.
